crossRefs.note: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

translations.web: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
translations.bsb: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or dart or arrow.
translations.kjv: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
translations.asv: If one lay at him with the sword, it cannot avail; Nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
